تستنشقون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْشِقُونَ (tastanšiqūna) /tas.tan.ʃi.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# تُسْتَنْشَقُونَ (tustanšaqūna) /tus.tan.ʃa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
